summary: Payment Gateway - Disable access to external entities in XML parsing (Severity: Blocker)
description: Overview. Application: Payment Gateway. Component: XML parsing across multiple classes. Rule ID: CWE-611, OWASP-A4. Multiple XML parsers instantiated without disabling external entity resolution (XXE). src/main/java/com/example/api/InvoiceResponseContainer.java Line 80 DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance() with no XXE protections. src/main/java/com/example/api/InvoiceImporter.java Line 157 TransformerFactory.newInstance(). src/main/java/com/example/api/InvoiceImporter.java Line 168 DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance(). src/main/java/com/example/util/XmlTools.java Line 41. SonarQube Rule: java:S2755. This ticket covers all 7 XXE instances across the Payment Gateway.
